abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Give

abilities.name: Message

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: Request a capability

abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.rationale: A real experiment confirmed new information; repeated facts do not qualify.

satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.

reviews.reason: Develop a general air-exposure food-preservation trial, including an equipment-free whole-food mode, in the current-conversation development handoff. The supplied related-capability searches and exact records show that gather transfers material, probe performs small observations or tests, and consult reads records; none implements a continuing preservation process. Search coverage is incomplete and the query budget is exhausted, so the handoff must check the remaining registry and reuse any equivalent handler before adding code. Mild spring conditions and edible roots do not establish that whole roots can dry sufficiently or safely. A real, potentially unsuccessful ventilation/drying trial is a feasible precursor; neither a guaranteed preserved product nor free equipment is justified. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for requesting, registration, learning, starting a timer, inspection clicks or a success label. If the existing experience engine supports it, a genuinely informative measured outcome, including failed drying or faster spoilage, may qualify for verified information gain only when measurements support a personally applicable new conclusion. Deduplicate equivalent observations and overlapping probe/trial claims by actor, batch, tested relation and evidence interval. This development proposes no new reward grant, account, budget, goal or permission change; use only already authorized bounded experience rules with their existing caps, cooldowns and decay. Repeated legitimate hands-on maintenance may count only under existing modest practice rules, not as unlimited novelty. Do not grant physical comfort from food placement; the comfort ceiling remains 10. Eating continues to supply basic nutrition independently of mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable, reusable events for actual placement, inspection, turning, environmental damage, removal, interruption and verified outcome, each carrying actor when applicable, exact batch and location references, mode, tick, progress state and publicly observable changes. Provide reusable food-batch visual metadata: component, resource appearance, placement/support, intact or altered form, exposed/in-progress/interrupted/removed/spoiled state, and visible surface changes only when supported. Keep analytical decay readings and uncertainty in the inspection report rather than pretending that a precise hidden value is visible. Do not show slices, smoke, racks, dryness, safety badges or preserved-food completion art without the corresponding real process and evidence. An incomplete, unsupported or failed trial must remain visibly pending, unverified or failed, never display preservation success. Observation events alone do not authorize experience rewards.
reviews.specification:
General operation: air-exposure preservation trial, parameterized by owned food stack ID, quantity, accessible placement location or existing support ID, and start/inspect/turn/stop mode. It is not specific to wren or roots. Minimum executable mode exposes intact food to actual local conditions; it does not imply cutting, cooking, firemaking, sterilization, construction or access to salt. Reuse and record foundation-forest@1 forest.gather for any separately gathered material, base navigation and ownership transfers where applicable, and foundation-open@1 open.probe for eligible observations. Do not relabel those functions as new inventions. Implement the missing persistent processing state and its integration with food decay in code, not through repeated reviewer decisions.
References and prerequisites: the currently supplied eligible input is item-5-wren-49, resource root, quantity 3, owner wren, harvestedAt 5. Tick-10 decay is 6.38045589; the applicant's tick-9 figure 5.28331244 is stale and must not reset the input. Resolve and revalidate the exact stack at execution, including intervening consumption or deterioration. reviews.reason: Reuse the existing general observation/sample-interaction operation as a non-ingestive assessment precursor. Its observe mode directly supports examining the actual sample without assuming nutrition or toxicity knowledge. The related eat, gather, consult, exchange and food-air-exposure-trial capabilities were also checked in the supplied retrievals. None supplies a validated toxicity assay or nutritional measurement: eating causes real exposure, and air exposure measures decay rather than safety. With the known equipment and evidence, nutrition and toxicity cannot be established reliably. This meets the request's explicit fallback without inventing a safe tasting test or a new duplicate observation capability.
reviews.experienceReview: The request, review, naming, consultation and any learning or registration award nothing. A completed observation may qualify only if its event verifies a personally relevant information gain, including a genuinely informative inability to discriminate; merely printing 'unknown' or repeating the same query is not a new discovery. Apply the established experience rules in code, not by repeated model judgment: deduplicate by functional subject/property/evidence, require a real event, and use existing bounded caps, decay and cooldowns. Familiar legitimate investigation may support only the existing modest maintained benefit when real participation occurs. reviews.reason: The related-capability searches supplied in the packet were considered. food-air-exposure-trial covers whole-food placement, controls, inspections and stopping, but expressly prevents whole-food water loss and supplies neither preparation nor water measurement. probe does not supply suitable equipment or a drying mechanism. These are not functionally equivalent to the requested prepared-food trial. Develop the missing general operation through the current-conversation handoff, reusing existing trial and food-physics code rather than claiming reinvention. Wren has three owned roots but no established suitable tool, preparation surface or measuring instrument. Development and review do not advance time, provide equipment or teach Wren automatically. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Functional food processing and evidence are distinct from experience benefit. Study, requests, naming, registration, waiting, selecting inputs and purported mastery earn no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed paid observation that verifies an applicable distinction, including an informative failure, may qualify only when its evidence is actually produced and its uncertainty is retained. Recommend at most 0.5 short pleasure per independently informative completed comparison, capped at 1 per 10 world rounds; replaying the same evidence across probe, this operation and food-air-exposure-trial does not qualify again. It decays to zero within 5 rounds. Legitimate completed practice may maintain at most 0.5 slowly maintained satisfaction, with at most 0.1 added per 10 rounds and 0.002 decay per world round; novelty is not required, but idle exposure and repeated button presses do not count. These are bounded proposals for the existing authorized experience channel only, not permission to modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions. If that channel cannot implement them lawfully, issue no experience award. No comfort bonus is intrinsic to drying or inspecting; physical comfort remains capped at 10 and basic nutrition is never reduced by mood. No rewards or benefit are granted at review time.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable preparation-start, unit-completed, placement, inspection, instrument-reading, interruption, resumption, stopping and material-loss events only when their underlying actions occur. Reusable metadata includes operation/trial ID, actor, actual item/tool/support IDs, location, quantities, geometry, work progress, timestamps, observation method, uncertainty and lifecycle status. Render portion geometry only after committed cutting and visible surface changes only when supported by the physical state. Modeled internal water totals are not visible measurement labels. Use explicit blocked, in-progress, stopped and inconclusive states; no dry, preserved, safe or success badge from elapsed time alone. Inspection shows the observations actually obtained, not an omniscient audit. Failed and incomplete work cannot display completed food, measured water loss or preservation success.
reviews.specification:
General operation: prepare and expose food, parameterized by owned input stack IDs, quantity, preparation mode, toolId, supportId, location, optional control IDs and optional measurement instrument IDs. Modes are prepare/start, inspect, stop and resume; unsupported material/method combinations fail explicitly. The smallest initial executable method is thin-section preparation of represented roots or berries followed by passive air exposure on a real suitable food surface. Whole-food comparison remains available through the existing food-air-exposure-trial implementation, not a duplicate invention. No heat, fire, equipment fabrication or food-safety certification is included.
REFERENCES AND REUSE: Reuse food-air-exposure-trial for trial identity, reservations, placement/reach checks, control release, elapsed-time records and termination; reuse the existing food decay and preservationPhysics version-1 audit state for food composition and weather integration. Record these dependencies and changed prepared-food behavior in the implementation. navigate, pickup and probe retain their own contracts and costs; this operation does not silently execute them. The fragment item-13-wren-127:air-exposure is incomplete evidence; do not manufacture its missing pages. The applicant reports the eight-round negative comparison, not a demonstrated preservation effect. Current possible inputs are item-22-wren-250, item-5-wren-49 and item-13-wren-128, each one root with decay 22.47744171 at this packet's snapshot; revalidate live state before action. The interface must accept other eligible actors and items, not hard-code these instances.
PREREQUISITES: Living participant, completed individual learning, sufficient energy, exact owned unreserved food quantities, reach to food/tool/support, and permission to use any non-owned equipment. Preparation requires an actual cutting implement whose geometry, material, edge and condition support the selected operation, and an actual stable food-contact surface with sufficient area and a recorded contamination condition. A sharp stone, cleanliness, suitable weather and support capacity cannot be assumed. Tool and surface qualification use observed properties and implemented physical checks, not an invented inventory tag alone. Missing checks/mechanisms go to this same development handoff. No tool or support is currently established, so preparation is presently blocked, not rejected forever. An exposed whole root or nearby plant is not a cutting tool or measuring device. Basic visual observation can establish only visible changes. Numerical mass comparison additionally requires an actual usable balance or equivalent instrument with represented resolution and calibration; none is established. This prerequisite must be stated before promising numerical water-loss observations.
COSTS AND WORK: Study requires 4 ordinary world rounds, 0.5 energy per completed round, no consumed study materials and no inventory grants. Preparation/start accepts at most one original whole food unit per work round; larger requests proceed as serial units. Each unit costs one round and 1.5 energy, plus the actual food transferred into prepared portions, all offcuts and any recorded tool wear. A control reserved from an owned stack is not consumed or duplicated. Reuse the existing trial's whole-unit quantity and placement accounting where applicable. Surface area and permitted portion geometry must be checked against actual support capacity before charging. Placement is part of that unit's start work only if the chosen support is already in reach; travel is separate. Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy for local visual observations and trial records. An instrument reading, if supported, costs an additional round and 0.5 energy per sample or control weighed, requires that instrument in reach and records its uncertainty. Consumable tests are unavailable until their actual materials and method are supplied; probe's paid sample consumption cannot be relabeled as a free measurement. Stop costs one round and no energy. Resume costs one round and 0.2 energy to revalidate/reposition surviving portions without cutting them again. All action preconditions are checked before charges. Drying has no guaranteed completion time: every world round of exposure advances real food/weather processes without free active work, while ordinary hunger and other world processes continue.
PHYSICS AND CONSERVATION: Initial splitting partitions the original edible dry matter, water, nutrients, toxins and decay history among retained portions and explicit offcuts; the original stack is debited exactly once. Offcuts remain real items or recorded waste, not extra edible output. Decay age is never reset. Cutting changes represented geometry and exposed area, not food quantity or nutrition by fiat. Version-1 assumed initial root/berry water fractions remain assumptions in internal audit state, not measured discoveries. Implement passive drying as a bounded moisture transfer driven by actual ambient temperature, humidity/evaporative demand, airflow, exposed geometry and exposure time; removal cannot exceed available transferable water, and absent a valid driving gradient there is no evaporation. Rain or wet contact may instead add actual environmental water. The handoff must bind this to explicit executable equations, units and coefficients consistent with the existing weather and food state before enabling prepared drying. Do not substitute a fixed percentage per round or a successful animation for the missing mechanism. Vapor leaves to the environment; runoff, detached matter, spilled material and any other modeled losses have separate ledger entries. Nutrients and toxins remain in retained matter unless an implemented process actually transfers or changes them. Reduced water may increase concentration; it never multiplies total nutrients or removes toxicity. Retain ordinary decay unless the existing physical model has a separately implemented moisture-dependent decay effect. Any such effect requires explicit code and must not retroactively rewrite the failed whole-root trial. Preservation and microbiological safety remain unverified.
EVIDENCE AND PRODUCTS: Produce identifiable prepared food portions, offcuts where any, a real exposure process and paid observation records, not a guaranteed dried ration. Record original source/lot, exact participants and IDs, preparation geometry/method, surface, tool, starting conditions, observation times, environmental exposure and control history. Prefer a same-stack untreated control when available; separate lots must be labeled confounded, not silently treated as matched. Each reading states whether it is visual, instrument-measured or an internal model assumption. Visual shriveling and absence of visible spoilage cannot establish water quantity, lack of spoilage or safety. Instrumental mass loss alone does not uniquely identify water loss: record rain, shedding, runoff, handling and instrument uncertainty and report residual ambiguity, including possible spoilage losses. A quantitative attribution to water requires an actual validated measurement method that separates those losses; otherwise report mass change only. A useful precursor may therefore prepare and expose food and record qualified visual observations, while numerical water attribution remains blocked on equipment/method. Decay comparisons use only the established trial inspection semantics and are labeled as model decay readings, not a new microbial test. No hidden food totals, local resources or future weather are disclosed to Wren.
LIFECYCLE: Keep per-unit committed work progress. A unit commits only when its work round completes; interruption before commitment charges only elapsed study/work actually performed and does not create prepared output. Already committed cuts, wear, spent energy and elapsed aging remain. Resume rechecks the surviving inputs and prerequisites and continues only unfinished work; committed preparation is never repeated or charged twice. Stopping or cancellation ends supervision and releases reserved controls once, leaving real food and offcuts at their actual locations; recovery uses pickup separately. Food left exposed continues its physical processes even without an open trial. Removing portions updates quantities; loss of all portions terminates the trial. Partial theft or removal does not clone replacement food. Death cancels pending work, releases control reservations and leaves material according to ordinary death/possession rules; it does not halt environmental drying or decay. Invalid requests have no charges; committed work has no energy, time, material or wear refund. No refund resets food age.
MAINTENANCE AND EXECUTION: Monitor real support condition, contact contamination, tool wear, obstruction and weather at each affected step. An unsuitable or broken support/tool prevents further affected work; only actual existing repair or cleaning methods may restore it, at their own costs. No automatic cleaning, sheltering, turning, fuel replenishment, retrieval or participant cooperation occurs. Other participants must independently communicate, consent where needed and act. Established checks, transfers, work progress, drying updates and reward deduplication execute in code after implementation, not through repeated model approval. The handoff must resolve the stated physics and measurement dependencies before advertising those modes as executable; it may enable the explicitly limited precursor first without implying the full trial succeeded.

Gathering one genuinely accessible loose unit uses gather, one round, 2 energy and decrements actual source stock by one; no quarrying or guaranteed flint. Ground pickup, if needed instead, uses pickup at one round and 1 + 0.2 times transferred mass energy. Gathering does not both consume stock and create an additional duplicate ground unit. args.name: Repeatable food mass comparison
args.function: Provide a physically grounded way to compare a food sample's mass before and after exposure, with stated resolution and limitations, rather than treating visible shrinkage as measured water loss.
args.conditions: A root slice trial showed visible shrinkage and lower model decay than a carried whole control after 13 rain-free rounds. Water and mass were not measured. No calibrated balance is known to exist. I carry one stone; nearby branches and loose stone sources have been observed, but their suitability is untested.
args.inputs: Potential local materials only if actually gathered and tested; a food sample and reference material if required. Construction method and reference stability are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; require real materials, work time and personal learning where needed. Do not create a calibrated instrument by declaration.
args.effects: If feasible, enable construction or use of a repeatable mass comparison with explicit uncertainty. Mass change alone must not establish water content, contamination, preservation or food safety. If infeasible, identify the missing physical prerequisites.
